Category router validation

Hypothesis: structured shirts should be generated from the raw Product Truth PLUS a source-preserving canonical Front; drape-sensitive blouses from the raw Product Truth alone. Six products, one generation per arm, identical model / base mannequin / size / aspect ratio / prompt template — the only variable is B's one extra attachment, whose manifest line names what it is and names no defect. No QC, no correction, no retries. The images are the evidence; the single Vision comparison per product is supporting only and is shown even when it disagrees.

Router verdict

CATEGORY_ROUTER_PROVEN

SHIRT → AUGMENTED: 2 of 3 (stripe, collar-stripe) show AUGMENTED materially better with no severe regression; check is MIXED. BLOUSE → RAW: 2 of 3 (4ff2132f, lace-top) show RAW materially better, and on 4ff2132f the augmented arm caused a listed severe regression (changed neckline). The tie-pintuck blouse dissents — the raw arm dropped the neck tie entirely, which is a missing major component. Six products decide a default, not a law, and RAW remains the fallback for everything not confidently a shirt.

Implemented

YES

app/services/generation_input_strategy.py — SHIRT + usable canonical → AUGMENTED; blouse, uncertain category, missing canonical, or any lookup failure → RAW. Product Truth is passed on every route; the canonical is an extra attachment in its own manifest slot and never replaces a source photograph. No production path produces canonical assets yet, so production behaviour is unchanged (every job resolves to RAW) until a producer is wired into the one seam that returns it.

STRIPE shirt (goldenset) SHIRT AUGMENTED

A washes both stripe colours into one pale beige and reads nearly plain; B restores the source's alternating taupe AND blue at visible contrast. Collar, placket and buttons equivalent. B's body is a little longer and looser than the cropped source — a drift, not an identity change.

supporting Vision comparison (1 call, temp 0): AUGMENTED — Both candidates are highly faithful representations of the shirt, capturing the stripe pattern, cropped silhouette, collar, and brand label accurately. However, the AUGMENTED version is slightly superior due to sharper rendering of the fine stripes, particularly on the sleeves where the RAW version shows some slight blurriness and smudging of the pattern.

CHECK / puckered shirt (goldenset) SHIRT MIXED

B renders the source's puckered/crinkled surface, which A leaves flat and smooth, and B's grid is slightly finer. But B also slims the relaxed, dropped-shoulder silhouette that A keeps. Each wins on something important.

supporting Vision comparison (1 call, temp 0): RAW vision disagrees — The original shirt has a very relaxed, oversized silhouette with dropped shoulders. The RAW candidate captures this drape and silhouette much more faithfully than the AUGMENTED candidate, which looks too fitted and structured. Both candidates struggle to fully replicate the highly puckered/crinkled texture of the original fabric, but RAW is overall a better representation.

4ff2132f — 소프트 골지 블라우스 레드 BLOUSE RAW

B renders the pointelle/rib surface better than A's plain body. But B turns the source's round scoop neckline into a square neck with a hard folded corner and pushes dusty mauve toward saturated rust. A keeps both correct. Surface texture is worth less than neckline and colour.

SEVERE REGRESSION — changed neckline (round scoop → square) and base colour shifted mauve → rust

supporting Vision comparison (1 call, temp 0): RAW — The RAW candidate is a much more faithful representation of the product. It correctly captures the distinct yoke panel construction with diagonal knit patterns and the gathers below it. The AUGMENTED candidate completely loses this yoke panel construction, simplifies the neckline, and changes the sleeve shape and color.

goldenset-lace-top — BLOUSE (sheer, empire seam, lettuce edge) BLOUSE RAW

A keeps the pale pink, the scoop neck with lettuce/picot edge, the bow sitting at the empire seam under the bust, and the hip length. B saturates the pink, raises the bow toward the collarbone and tightens the body.

supporting Vision comparison (1 call, temp 0): RAW — The RAW candidate is highly faithful to the real product, correctly capturing the wide scoop neckline with lettuce trim, the straight horizontal lace trim across the chest, and the small bow positioned in the center of that trim. The AUGMENTED candidate incorrectly places the bow at the center of the neckline, curves the under-bust seam, and omits the lace trim detail.

타이 핀턱 셔링 블라우스 — BLOUSE BLOUSE AUGMENTED

The source has fabric ties hanging at the neck opening. A renders no tie at all; B renders it as a tied bow. Pintucks, shirred waist seam, peplum and banded sleeves are equivalent in both. The dissenting case for the blouse rule.

SEVERE REGRESSION — RAW drops the neck tie entirely — a missing major component

supporting Vision comparison (1 call, temp 0): NEITHER vision disagrees — Both candidate images are exceptionally faithful representations of the real product. They both accurately depict the raglan sleeve construction with horizontal pintucks, the vertical pintucks on the chest, the gathered tier, and the fabric texture. RAW shows the neck ties hanging loose, while AUGMENTED shows them tied in a bow, both of which are valid and high-quality commercial presentations.
